name: The Return of Zero — the sovereign reading path
description: Eight station scenes in reading order (§0/1 → §0 → §1 → §2 → §3 → §4 → §5 → §5→0) and the closing return (M48 → M01) as one continuous path. Binds to THE-RETURN-OF-ZERO.md and the eight section rooms at Antykathera-Essay-Work dbf3b17.

scenes.name: §0/1 — The Integral Threshold
scenes.character: Station 1 of 8 — The subject at the formal limit, before any notation.

scenes.name: §0 — Differentiating Mind
scenes.character: Station 2 of 8 — Objective internality derived from differentiating activity.

scenes.name: §1 — The Return of Zero
scenes.character: Station 3 of 8 — Zero's history and generativity until `0/1` is earned.

scenes.name: §2 — Two Logics of Two
scenes.character: Station 4 of 8 — Dia-ballein and sym-ballein, the two accountings of polarity.

scenes.name: §3 — Mathematical Substrate
scenes.character: Station 5 of 8 — The derivational braid from `0/1` to the arche-topos.

scenes.name: §4 — Psychoid Flowering
scenes.character: Station 6 of 8 — Jung, Pauli, Lacan and Gebser, each performing one move.

scenes.name: §5 — Objective Internality
scenes.character: Station 7 of 8 — Six products — Central, Actuation, AIKit, Software Factory, Workcell, Quaternal Logic — without settling the metaphysics of consciousness.

scenes.name: §5→0 — Epi-Logos and 4:2 Technē — The Instrument Returns
scenes.character: Station 8 of 8 — Implementable architecture and a proportionate horizon; the mechanism finally enters.

scenes.name: The Return — M48 → M01
scenes.character: The closing return: the reading path comes back to its opening with more, not less, differentiation.
